connector.name: Payfetch
connector.registryDescription: x402 paying-fetch client for AI agents. Spending caps, approval, receipts. Non-custodial.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package payfetch. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the forum-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PAYFETCH_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: 0x-hex EVM private key for a DEDICATED low-balance wallet. Set exactly ONE signer source.

env.name: PAYFETCH_KEY_FILE
env.description: Path to a chmod-600 file holding a 0x-hex key (signer alt).

env.name: PAYFETCH_CDP_API_KEY_ID
env.description: Coinbase CDP server-wallet key id (YOUR account).

env.name: PAYFETCH_TEST_MODE
env.description: Any value -> receipts test:true, Base mainnet refused (Sepolia only).

env.name: PAYFETCH_APPROVER
env.description: Set to 1 to grant approval authority (never with a queue-capable mode).

env.name: PAYFETCH_VIA
env.description: Optional via= attribution slug sent on guard calls only.
